sentences.text: 4. Mr. Johnsey Macwan, learned advocate appearing for the applicant submits that the applicant herein is the husband of the respondent no.2- original complainant and their marriage was solemnized on 20.01.2022 as per the Hindu rites and rituals.
He further submits that after a lapse of some time, the disputes cropped up between them and therefore, the complainant had gone to her parental home on 28.08.2022.
It is the case of the applicant that the applicant herein had gone to the London, whereas, the so-called FIR is registered on 20.09.2022.

He further submits that pursuant to the registration of the FIR, the investigation commenced and ultimately, at the end of day, charge-sheet was submitted before the concerned court against all the accused except the present applicant.
The applicant has been shown as absconding accused in the charge-sheet.
So far as other accused persons are concerned, the trial has already been proceed with and ultimately, at the end of day, the learned trial court has acquitted them vide order dated 28.08.2024.
He has already been annexed a copy of acquittal order so far as the co-accused persons are concerned.
Then-after, the applicant has come back to India and he has preferred present application on merit.

He further submits that during the pendency of present proceedings, the matter has already been settled between the parties and the complainant is not willing NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/3932/2025 ORDER DATED: 06/03/2025 undefined to carry out the proceedings further.
The complainant has filed affidavit specifically stating the said fact that if the proceedings of present complaint is quashed, in that event, she has no objection.
An affidavit to that effect has also been filed by the complainant.
It is, therefore, urged that the present applications may be allowed.

5. Learned advocate Mr. Rasmin Makwana for the respondent no.2 - original complainant has submitted that the respondent no.2 - complainant has personally remained present before this court on virtual mode and she has no objections, if the proceedings qua the present applicant would be quashed.
Learned advocate further submits that the disputes is settled between the parties and an affidavit in that regard is already filed by the complainant.

Learned advocate has identified the signature of the complainant as well as identified the respondent no.2 - original complainant, who is present before this Court and also confirmed correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her.
6.
Learned APP has submitted that appropriate order may be passed on the strength of the settlement arrived at between the parties.

7. Therefore, since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through his learned advocate,
the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/3932/2025 ORDER DATED: 06/03/2025 undefined of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.

It is also pertinent to note that the learned trial court has already been proceeded with the proceedings of criminal case No.336 of 2022 and acquitted all the accused persons vide order dated 28.08.2024 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Petlad.
